Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: We could not finish this test, so a person needs to check it. The page has an embedded frame we could not read that we cannot check automatically; please check it works with the keyboard. "Country:" (list) works with a mouse but can't be reached with the keyboard; please check whether something else on the page does the same thing. The Tab walk did not get through the whole page, so elements past that point were not checked. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).

Criteria.TestCondition: There is no keyboard trap.
Criteria.TesterComment: We moved through the whole page with Tab and with Shift+Tab, and keyboard focus never got trapped. At one point keyboard focus kept cycling between "#popmake-872473 > div", "Yes" (radio), "Submit" (button), "Close" (button), but pressing Shift+Tab moves focus back out, so it is not a trap. The page seems to load more content as you scroll, and the recording could not show all of it; content after the feed was reached only by Shift+Tab from the end. 3 collapsed control(s) (menus, accordions) were not opened; content behind them was not checked for traps.
